checks.name: device context is not delivered phone; no business identities allocated
phone explicitly included once, removed deliberately, and model is not a physical SKU
switch context retains selected goods and old phone; explicit combined replacement preserves count
same stable SKU merges; equal names, SPU and specifications never merge distinct IDs
MAT, PLN, SPU and nonexistent records cannot masquerade as sales goods
invalid quantities are rejected without rounding or truncation; merging and multiplication guard overflow
service per-package and per-delivery quantities stay separate; terms are never multiplied
ordinary bundle is explicitly unchecked and does not claim universal device compatibility
directly selected phones freeze actual delivered hosts without choosing a compatibility context
conditional manual acknowledgement records exact basis and never edits global declarations
acknowledgement expires on quantity, service, device, rule or relevant declaration changes
pending and explicit incompatibility cannot be promoted by manual package acknowledgement
basic charge does not imply fast charge; only explicit fast requirement adds its prerequisite
exact frozen PLN is reused; other PLN does not enter current-device package
standalone model context works without delivering a fake device or inventing a PLN
unconfigured and missing device references retain draft but block available and delivery
unquoted, zero and two decimals are distinct; invalid money and total overflow rejected
composition change keeps manual quote as review reference, without pretending a calculated price
optional rules disabled preserve free composition; candidates are never auto-selected
kind-count and per-kind quantities have independent constraints; optional zero selection allowed
SKU cannot satisfy two enabled groups; stale candidate references remain explicit problems
copy is deep, new identity, no old confirmations/request/history, quote reference needs review
off-sale or deleted items retain saved text, allow draft, and block new formal delivery
draft and disabled packages cannot generate formal deliveries
current goods, group, device, model and type references protect objects; snapshots alone do not
fresh preview revalidates changed declarations and conditions, never trusts stale canConfirm
delivery freezes complete SKU, services, abilities, quote, source revision and conditions independently
old data absence and repeated serialization preserve optional arrays and independently readable snapshots
import rejects malformed quantity, quote, measurements, duplicate identities and request collisions
query, validation, candidate filtering, preview and copy preserve all original business arrays and input

unconfigured, explicit empty, inherited default and explicit negative remain distinct
multiple identical full replacements deduplicate and retain exact origin pairs
every result-affecting field participates in multi-exception conflict; no order/depth priority
condition/value order normalization preserves full content equality
selector identity uses actual node/attribute/value/ancestor scope and never display names
invalid host, condition and scope references block affected output rather than falling back
published snapshots are independent and preserve fallback roles/names/history
compatibility-only edits are publish differences; no-op revision/timestamp edits are not
old versions with only legacy metadata are unconfigured and never borrow current draft
strong cross-version mapping preserves identity; recreated nodes and ambiguous subsets fail
legacy conversion is explicit, provable, pending, idempotent and preserves old/history arrays
save/clone/export-import round trips preserve new fields and unknown extension fields
full combination selectors preserve tuple boundaries and cannot match partial OR fragments
operation-local SKU/MAT identity index preserves receipt/code/explicit/legacy precedence
malformed frozen configuration is reported without current-draft fallback or exceptions
pure preview and validation consume no random IDs or clock values and can reuse prepared context
an incomplete exception keeps actual structure available to repair scope in one context
draft-only edits reuse structural indexes without changing effective results or input
prepared incomplete drafts expose field locations and recover on correction
Vue structural dependencies invalidate indexes while text edits only revalidate rules

performance.method: Domain microbenchmark of 12 successive evidence edits: original createContext vs one structural context plus fresh prepare per edit. Includes one after structural build; one warmup plus five measured rounds; final full effective results compared by SHA256 outside timed edit loop. This is not end-to-end typing latency or a UI FPS claim.

batchPerformance.method: Real batch materialization and read-only three-way sync preview, one warmup and five measured runs. Full independent data clone occurs outside materialization timing. Every batch mixes separate SKU/MAT targets; history arrays, IDs and business time fixed. All created rows and sync update counts asserted, with untouched input and read-only preview asserted. This records the new feature cost, not a comparison to the pre-feature application.
